name: cadre-lifecycle-gitlab
description: GitLab-flavored Agentic SDLC gate governance: lifecycle-review-gitlab records gate decisions from a real GitLab MR approval (approve-from-gitlab/approve-from-gitlab-mr); gitlab-gate-tracking publishes GitLab tracking issues for a task's gates and assigns linked approval-subtask issues to each gate's authority (create-gate-issues/list-gate-issues). Requires cadre-lifecycle-core to also be installed and a recent-enough agentic-sdlc kernel.

interface.shortDescription: Record Agentic SDLC gate decisions and publish gate/approval tracking issues in GitLab.
interface.longDescription: Conversationally record a lifecycle gate decision sourced from an actual GitLab merge request approval (approve-from-gitlab/approve-from-gitlab-mr), or publish GitLab tracking issues for a task's gates with linked approval subtasks assigned to each gate's authority (create-gate-issues/list-gate-issues). Requires cadre-lifecycle-core.
defaultPrompt: Use lifecycle-review-gitlab to record a gate decision from a GitLab MR approval.
Use gitlab-gate-tracking to publish GitLab issues for this task's gates and approvals.
